title: Applicability boundaries of NMF detrital-zircon unmixing — reproducibility package
description: Code and data accompanying Pan, L., "Where does detrital-zircon source unmixing break? An analytic identifiability criterion and its large-scale Monte-Carlo verification for NMF provenance unmixing" (submitted to Computers & Geosciences). Reproduces every figure: the synthetic data generator, the HPC scan harness (supervised and unsupervised KL-NMF), the merge and figure-generation scripts, the identifiability-theory verification scripts (direct sigma_err measurement on the (rho, n) plane), the per-axis results, and the per-cell 3D phase-atlas summary. The full per-seed atlas raw (559 MB; 187 MB gzipped) is archived as a separate data record.
